The memo appropriately captures all the key financial and material terms that are actually disclosed in the source document. The amendment document itself does not contain fundamental commercial terms like loan amounts, interest rates, maturity dates, or specific covenant details - it only modifies certain definitional and procedural aspects of the original June 11, 2021 credit agreement. The memo correctly notes these limitations by indicating "N/A" for terms not disclosed and explicitly states that "this amendment modifies an existing credit agreement but does not disclose the fundamental commercial terms." All material information that is available in the source document (parties, guarantor structure, governing law, administrative agent, lenders, etc.) has been properly captured in the memo.
